svg.aria-label: Two of the posting rules, line by line. The value rule compares the order total with the cap from the policy file in plain code, with no AI involved. The stock rule reads the on-hand quantity from the Business Central item record and builds the sentence the person reads on the blocked card. The numbers live in a policy file and can be changed there.
svg.text: Two of the rules, in code
From checks.py and the policy file, trimmed. The notes are mine
# rule: order value within the cap
total = _f(order.get('totalAmountExcludingTax'))
cap = _f(policy['max_order_value_excl_tax'])
add('value', f'Order value within cap ({cap:,.2f})',
'pass' if total <= cap else 'fail', f'order total excl. tax = {total:,.2f}')

text.font-family: 'Bradley Hand', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Segoe Print', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive

svg.text: plain code: it compares two numbers.

text.font-family: 'Bradley Hand', 'Chalkboard SE', 'Segoe Print', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive

svg.text: No AI is involved in this decision
# rule: stock covers the order, per item
inv = _f((items.get(no) or {}).get('inventory'))
